main_text.l: VII. LITERÆ DANIÆ REGIS AD HENRICUM III. Galliæ Regem.

Fredericus II. Dei gratia Daniæ, Norvegiæ, Gothorum, Vandalorum Rex: Dux Slesvici, Holsatiæ, Stormariæ ac Ditmarsiæ: Comes in Oldenburgh & Delmenhorst. Serenissimo & Christianissimo Principi Domino Henrico Gallorum Regi, Consanguineo & fratri nostro charissimo, salutem & continuum felicitatis incrementum.

page.notes: The "Fredericus II." opening words are set in small capitals; rendered here in italic-free roman. Catchword is partly cut off at the margin.
